name: @rmrdeveloper/sideroom-pi
description: A global Pi package that runs an isolated coding-agent pipeline through /sideroom.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.test: node --test src/core/agents.test.ts src/core/catalog.test.ts src/core/findings.test.ts src/core/grilling.test.ts src/core/orchestrator.test.ts src/pi-command.test.ts src/runtimes/pi.test.ts
scripts.format: biome format --write src package.json biome.json commitlint.config.mjs .changeset/config.json
scripts.format:check: biome format src package.json biome.json commitlint.config.mjs .changeset/config.json
scripts.check: npm run types && biome check src package.json biome.json commitlint.config.mjs .changeset/config.json && npm test
